method: Isolated PhysX at the production 0.005 second timestep. Saved forklift, pallet, cargo and rack prefabs. Pickup, carrying and release use actual contacts; no load parenting, attached carrying joints or pose writes after initial placement.

checks.name: measured pallet and rack geometry
checks.expectation: Every pallet has independent dynamic collision, open front fork pockets and actual placement anchors at floor and both raised rack levels.

measurements.name: installed pallets with independent dynamic bodies

checks.name: physical full lift travel
checks.expectation: Finite hydraulic actuation raises the actual forks above the highest measured rack pocket, retaining clearance for a 100 mm pickup.

measurements.name: fork top required for upper pickup with 100 mm clearance

checks.name: compact mast retains guide and cylinder engagement
checks.expectation: The lowered visual and physical mast fit the original trailer; at full hydraulic travel both guide stages remain engaged, chain anchors stay below the sheaves and the polished rods retain barrel overlap.

measurements.name: lowered carriage guide edge above inner rail foot
fully extended carriage guide edge below rail top
inner lower guide edge below outer rail top
fixed upper guide edge above inner rail foot
fully extended sheave above carriage chain anchor
fully extended polished piston barrel overlap

checks.name: Pallet_01_Fresh_Pine floor pickup transport release
checks.expectation: Drive in from outside the pallet, lift through fork contact, reverse with the independent load, lower and withdraw without carrying the released pallet.

checks.name: pause clears held hydraulic input
checks.expectation: Deactivation clears lift and tilt commands immediately; reactivation without fresh input cannot resume their motion.
